summary: Frontend-only testing of centralized AuthContext refactor. Executed 12 scenarios covering admin/master login, invalid credentials, route protection (unauth + cross-role), sidebar nav rendering, dashboard data loading, Telegram settings navigation, logout flows, and public pages. All 12 scenarios PASSED.

integration_issues.issue: Console errors: 403 on masters stats endpoint - 'Помилка завантаження статистики майстрів'. Master appears to call an admin-only stats API on dashboard load. Not part of this refactor but should be reviewed.

issues: React warning: 'Each child in a list should have a unique key prop' in AdminOverview render - missing key prop in a mapped list

action_items: (Optional) Add unique key prop in AdminOverview list rendering to silence React console warning
(Optional) Investigate 403s on masters stats endpoint invoked from master dashboard - master role likely shouldn't call that admin endpoint
critical_code_review_comments: AuthContext.js: Clean implementation with useCallback/useMemo. loadInitialState correctly prefers admin token over master, but if both tokens somehow coexist in localStorage, master session becomes unreachable until admin token is cleared - consider validating/prioritizing based on last-login timestamp.
api.js interceptor picks adminToken || masterToken - same coexistence concern; because logout() clears both keys this is fine in the happy path.
ProtectedRoute in App.js correctly enforces role match (userRole !== role), providing cross-role protection as verified by tests.
context_for_next_testing_agent: AuthContext refactor is functional end-to-end. Verified: (1) unauth redirects to /admin/login and /master/login, (2) invalid creds show correct Ukrainian toasts ('Невірні облікові дані' / 'Невірний email або пароль'), (3) admin login lands on /admin/analytics with all 5 nav items and stat cards, (4) master login lands on /master/dashboard displaying 'Олена Коваль', 'olena@example.com', all 8 nav items, Telegram page loads, (5) cross-role blocked both ways, (6) logout clears state and redirects correctly, (7) public / and /booking accessible. Minor: React key warning in AdminOverview and 403 on master calling admin stats endpoint - both pre-existing, not caused by refactor.
rca of the issue: N/A - no bugs found in the refactor scope.
